entities.name: Cori Mountain Monastery
entities.description: A remote Jeskai sanctuary on Tarkir built in a flooded volcanic caldera, a retreat and training ground for monks.

entities.name: Jeskai
entities.description: The clan whose Way the monastery teaches.

entities.name: Tiansun
entities.description: The rugged peaks hiding the monastery.

entities.name: Ojutai
entities.description: Dragon whose purge nearly destroyed the original Jeskai teachings.

entities.name: Shu Yun
entities.description: Author of the ancient writings preserved in a hidden archive.

entities.name: Asham
entities.description: A young monk of Cori Mountain Monastery.

entities.name: Ru
entities.description: Asham's childhood friend and love who rescued him.

entities.name: Ai Wen
entities.description: A seasoned Temur warrior who twice defeated Asham.

events.summary: A hidden archive survives Ojutai's purge, preserving Shu Yun's writings and founding the reborn Jeskai Way.
events.quote: a hidden archive survived Ojutai ’s purge, preserving the ancient writings of Shu Yun

events.summary: Asham fails to manifest flames in training; Ru visits and reassures him.
events.quote: his childhood friend Ru visited him

events.summary: Ai Wen defeats Asham again, leaving him badly injured; Ru rescues him.
events.quote: She easily defeated him again, highlighting the vast difference in their skill

events.summary: Asham resolves to travel to other monasteries and clans, reaffirming his bond with Ru.
events.quote: Asham and Ru reaffirmed their bond of love as Asham set out on a new journey of personal growth.

relations.quote: Asham , a young monk of Cori Mountain Monastery

relations.note: Childhood friends who reaffirmed their bond of love.
relations.quote: Asham and Ru reaffirmed their bond of love
